turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague who will take over and review the earlier decision. I noted that you described a raised scratch across the ink, not a mark in the artwork.

input.summary: Customer disputes an earlier damage decision that described the reported scrape as part of the artwork. They say it is a raised scratch across the ink and want the decision reviewed. No order number or email provided.
